verdict.rationale: HubSpot ships Breeze AI features that generate insights directly from CRM data, e.g. natural-language report building ('describe the report you need in plain language, and HubSpot will build it from your actual data'), AI agents that surface buying signals and suggest next steps ('Prospecting agent watches accounts for signals... smart deal progression keeps deals moving after every call, with next steps handled for them'), and automatic CRM update/follow-up draft suggestions after meetings. These are first-party product docs describing in-product AI-generated insights/suggestions, not just API/agent connectivity. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of insight quality and no third-party review confirming these Breeze features work as advertised in practice.
